szoveg_eredeti:
From November 10 to 12, Kling AI joined Adobe MAX 2026 in Miami, Florida, connecting with global brands, agencies, and creators to explore the role of AI video in professional creative workflows.

Under the theme "Bringing AI Video into Professional Creative Workflow", Kling 4.0 showcased a range of creative applications, highlighting new possibilities for ideation and content production. As model capabilities continue to advance, creative teams can explore more directions and bring more ideas to life.

Kling AI will continue working with industry partners around the world to integrate its models more naturally into professional content production and help turn more creative ideas into reality.
